svg.title: Breadth-first search, ring by ring
svg.desc: An animation of breadth-first search on the 3 by 3 grid, (0, 0) at the bottom-left, with the center (1, 1) blocked, from S at (0, 0) to D at (2, 2). The start gets 0 and goes on the to-visit list. Each step takes the oldest intersection from the front of the list, and every open neighbor without a number gets the next number, an arrow showing where it came from, and a place at the back of the list: (1, 0) and (0, 1) get 1, (2, 0) and (0, 2) get 2, (2, 1) and (1, 2) get 3, and (2, 2) gets 4. When (1, 2) is taken its neighbors already have numbers, so nothing new is written. When (2, 2) is taken the search stops, and walking back along the arrows gives the path [(1, 0), (2, 0), (2, 1), (2, 2)]. The animation repeats.

g.text: It goes on the to-visit list.
